# LootWiki

> Hand-researched game guides, one hub.

- [Beast of Reincarnation](https://lootwiki.com/beast-of-reincarnation/en/): Game Freak's first AAA action RPG: a one-person, one-dog souls-like set in Japan, Year 4026. Nushi boss strategies with per-chapter levels and weaknesses, Emma's builds and skill trees, Koo's command system, trophy data and patch tracking — rewritten from the live game after launch.
- [Shift At Midnight](https://lootwiki.com/shift-at-midnight/): The graveyard-shift horror sim where your customers might be doppelgangers. Every monster from Marionette to the Dentist with tells and counters, all 10 achievements with rarity data, every ending, night-by-night survival guides and a straight answer on crossplay.
- [DragonSword: Awakening](https://lootwiki.com/dragonsword-awakening/): An anime-style open-world action RPG set on the Continent of Orbis. How Status Ailment tag-team combat actually works, all 19 Heroes with a tier list, the Cooking and Familiar systems, chapter bosses, gear, runes and Karma — every number from verified sources.
- [Sephiria](https://lootwiki.com/sephiria/): The top-down action roguelite from the studio behind Dungeon Squad. All 6 weapon classes, the Artifact and Tablet inventory system, build routes, every boss chapter and the final boss's endings, plus patch notes tracked through 1.0.30 — with 4-player co-op covered.
- [Sir, We Have an Orc Problem](https://lootwiki.com/orc-problem/): An incremental-style tower defense about holding the line against tens of thousands of orcs. Real turret numbers for every tower, all four abilities, the upgrade grind, level challenges from the 3-2 difficulty spike to damageless runs, and achievements mapped to levels.
- [Valheim](https://lootwiki.com/valheim/): Our Valheim hub for Iron Gate's Viking survival game, in English and Chinese: a first-day checklist, the progression order through every biome, eight boss guides from Eikthyr to Kall Fimbulbringer, the Deep North and Intricate Key chain, plus food, portals, sailing and co-op server care — every guide lists its numbered sources.
- [BlockSpin](https://lootwiki.com/blockspin/): Our BlockSpin hub for the Roblox open-world crime game by Cinnamon Go!: the official new-player code, the death-drop rule and house safe, developer, rating and platform facts, and the rules on exploits and bans — built only from official sources, with every guide dated.
- [Deep Fishing](https://lootwiki.com/deep-fishing/): Our Deep Fishing hub for LazyGames' Roblox fishing simulator: how the cast-sell-upgrade loop works, all 21 rods in order with official Robux prices, nine game passes, the Robux shop, and rarity odds worked out from official badge totals — built from Roblox's own data, with no unverified codes.
- [Bongo Cat](https://lootwiki.com/bongo-cat/): Our Bongo Cat hub for Irox Games' free Steam desktop pet: how taps pay for chests, the official drop rates per rarity, the exchange and trading rules, Steam Error fixes, the keylogger question answered with the developer's own posts, the event and Paw Pass timeline, and all 28 achievements — every guide lists its numbered sources.
- [Untitled Wheelie Game](https://lootwiki.com/untitled-wheelie-game/): Our Untitled Wheelie Game hub for Untitled Wheelie Group's Roblox motorbike game: what you can do on the map, how to earn money, all 12 game passes with official Robux prices, cash packs, Backfire parts, police fines and the update history — built from Roblox's own data, with no unverified codes.
- [Animal Daycare (Anomaly)](https://lootwiki.com/animal-daycare/): Our Animal Daycare (Anomaly) hub for Day Dreams Games' Roblox survival game: what a shift asks of you from the developer's own description, all five badges with survival odds from official totals, and every Robux product and Lamb Coin pack — built from Roblox's own data, with no unverified codes.
- [[W3] +1 Mog Evolution](https://lootwiki.com/mog-evolution/): Our +1 Mog Evolution hub for Navoj Mog's Roblox clicker: how clicking, the Bonesmash hammer, Wins and Ascend fit together, Rebirth, Stages and Worlds 2-3, the Admin Abuse & Update 4 event, and all 43 Robux products with official prices — built from Roblox's own data, with no unverified codes.
- [Race Horses](https://lootwiki.com/race-horses/): Our Race Horses hub for Gorilla Grafters' idle Roblox racing game: all 24 badges with official award counts, seven egg tiers up to Exotic with Robux prices, what the developer says about the Index, every game pass and gift price, and an update timeline — built from Roblox's own data, with no unverified codes.
- [+1 Stone Skipping](https://lootwiki.com/stone-skipping/): Our +1 Stone Skipping hub for Meow Labs' Roblox simulator: how Skill, levels, zones, Wins, pets and Rebirth fit together, the ADMIN ABUSE + WORLD 5 event time, all 11 game passes and all 78 Robux products with official prices — built from Roblox's own data, with no unverified codes.
- [Southern Mudding](https://lootwiki.com/southern-mudding/): Our Southern Mudding hub for the verified Roblox group's off-road driving game: all 13 game passes and their gift prices, 22 vehicles sold for Robux, spawn limits and trailers, what the nitrous update confirms, four badges with official award counts, and the Friday update schedule — built from Roblox's own data, with no unverified codes.
- [Roblox Stock Exchange 2](https://lootwiki.com/roblox-stock-exchange-2/): Our Roblox Stock Exchange 2 hub for Summit Productions Development's trading simulator: the one code printed in the official description (not tested in game), all 13 game passes with their official descriptions and prices, all 31 Robux products, 11 badges with official award counts, what is and is not published about algo bots, and every official update event listing — built from Roblox's own data, with no unverified codes and no financial advice.
